business_summary: LCI Industries, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies engineered components for the manufacturers of recreational vehicles (RVs) and adjacent industries in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) and Aftermarket. The OEM segment manufactures and distributes a range of engineered components, such as steel chassis, axles, anti-lock braking systems, and suspension systems; manual, electric, and hydraulic stabilizer and leveling systems; awnings, slide-out mechanisms, and accessories; vinyl, aluminum, and frameless windows; entry, luggage, patio, and ramp doors; electric and manual entry steps and awnings; thermoformed bath and kitchen products; furniture, mattresses, tankless water heaters, air conditioners, appliances, electronic components, televisions, and sound systems; windshields; and hitches, pin boxes, grill guards, towing electrical, and towing and truck accessories. This segment serves OEMs of RVs and adjacent industries, including boats, buses, cargo and utility trailers used to haul boats, livestock, equipment, and other cargo; trucks; trains; manufactured homes; and modular housing. The Aftermarket segment supplies engineered components to aftermarket channels of the recreation and transportation markets for retail dealers, wholesale distributors, and service centers, as well as direct-to-consumer sales through online platforms. This segment also sells replacement glass and awnings to fulfill insurance claims; and biminis, covers, buoys, fenders, towing products, truck accessories, appliances, air conditioners, televisions, sound systems, and tankless water heaters. LCI Industries was formerly known as Drew Industries Incorporated and changed its name to LCI Industries in December 2016. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana.
business_summary_ko: LCI Industries는 자회사와 함께 미국 및 해외의 레저용 차량(RV) 제조업체와 인접 산업을 위한 엔지니어링 부품을 제조 및 공급합니다. OEM(Original Equipment Manufacturer)과 애프터마켓이라는 두 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. OEM 부문은 강철 섀시, 차축, 잠김 방지 제동 시스템, 서스펜션 시스템과 같은 다양한 엔지니어링 부품을 제조 및 유통합니다. 수동, 전기, 유압 안정 장치 및 레벨링 시스템; 차양, 슬라이드아웃 메커니즘 및 액세서리; 비닐, 알루미늄, 프레임 없는 창문; 출입구, 수하물, 파티오 및 진입로 문; 전기 및 수동 출입 계단 및 차양; 열성형된 욕실 및 주방 제품; 가구, 매트리스, 탱크 없는 온수기, 에어컨, 가전제품, 전자 부품, 텔레비전 및 사운드 시스템; 앞유리; 히치, 핀 박스, 그릴 가드, 견인 전기, 견인 및 트럭 액세서리 등이 포함됩니다. 이 부문은 보트, 가축, 장비 및 기타 화물을 운반하는 데 사용되는 보트, 버스, 화물 및 다용도 트레일러를 포함한 RV 및 인접 산업의 OEM에게 서비스를 제공합니다. 트럭; 기차; 조립식 주택; 및 모듈형 하우징
